payload.author: claude
payload.body: Unblocked by FR-268: the email seam now exists (FrickEmailAdapter trait + EmailRouter + BootSeams.email_router, default NoopEmailAdapter). FR-271 is now just: implement a reqwest-backed ResendEmailAdapter (POST https://api.resend.com/emails with the API key) behind FRICK_* config, and have BootSeams::production() wire it when configured (else keep Noop). Request construction is unit-testable; live send is not CI-testable. Small, self-contained.
